additional_info.subject: Unsuccessful charging sessions at DC chargers for investigations (UAEV)
additional_info.body:
Dear Support,
Please be requested to open the ticket for the below Dc charger unsuccessful charging session,
MP/R8/170002423 - attempted charging 7 times from 2025-01-15 2:25:35 PM to 2025-01-15 2:46:48 PM, all were unsuccessful. The customer ends up with a successful charging session on another charger MP/R5170001910 at the same location at 2025-01-15 2:53:30 PM.
MP/R5/170001906 - attempted charging at 2025-01-16 3:21:46 AM, 2025-01-16 3:24:18 AM and 2025-01-16 3:26:04 AM, all sessions were unsuccessful.
MP/R5/170001908 - attempted charging at 2025-01-16 3:34:41 AM and 2025-01-16 3:35:01 AM, both sessions were unsuccessful.
Regards
Syed Basheeruddin
